d:
Learn Spark Structured Streaming by building a complete real-world Data Engineering project from scratch!
In this hands-on tutorial, a Sr Data Architect will build an end-to-end streaming data pipeline using Databricks Free Edition, Confluent Kafka, PostgreSQL, and Spark Structured Streaming. You'll learn both the implementation and the theory behind real-time data processing.
This project is ideal for:
Data Engineers
Spark Developers
Databricks Learners
Kafka Beginners
Interview Preparation
